newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers seen rising on higher cargo.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers seen rising on higher cargo.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were expected to be quoted higher on Thursday along with firmer fuel oil and gas oil cargo prices, traders said.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted around $124-$126 and 380-cst at between $120-$121, about a dollar over Wednesday's levels.

"Shipowners are concerned about rising prices here and are asking for bunker quotes from other ports for comparison," a broker said. "With the standoff in demand due to high prices and as more fuel arbitrage cargoes coming this way in October, sellers believe prices will eventually slump."
